content: ARL2, also known as ADP-ribosylation factor-like protein 2, is a protein in humans that is encoded by the ARL2 gene. The ADP-ribosylation factor (ARF) genes belong to a family of small GTP-binding proteins that are part of the RAS superfamily. ARL2 is a member of a functionally distinct subgroup within the ARF-like gene family. ARL2 has been demonstrated to interact with several proteins, including the protein unc-119 homolog, TBCD (tubulin-specific chaperone D), and PDE6D (phosphodiesterase 6D).
